svg.title: Sets by number of elements
svg.desc: Fill time per element and lookup time of std::set, std::unordered_set, amc::FlatSet and amc::SmallSet from 2 to 4096 elements.
svg.text: Fill: insertions in random order in an empty set, then destruction. Lookups: half of the values are present.
